informal_statement: Normalized cap area is continuous on (0,pi).
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:212-216, the source contract is `lemma area_continuousOn : ContinuousOn area (Ioo 0 π)`.
